page.layout: One page of text; a decorative headpiece above the title; margin notes right (faint catchmarks and small marks in the right margin, not legible as text). Below the text at right: signature C. ij.

main_text.head: GEORGII BVCHANANI SCOTI Fratres Fraterrimi.
main_text.p: O Fama prisci laudibus saecli tumens, Prasens superbo despuens fastidio, Accede, spectla quid priorum temporum Opponat aetas nostra magniloquentia: Non quod Platoni, vel Socrati, Sophisq; falso dictitatis comparet, Sed Christiana puritatis unicum Exemplar, unum specimen, unam imaginem, Vt namque vitae corrigenda regulam, Vt numque Christi proximè vestigia Qui persequatur, indicetque caeteris, Vitamque vitae penitus exprimat suae, Antonium Tomarianum Antistitem.

Christi parentum nemo vidit alterum, Nec ipsa mater novit Antoni patrem. Verterque pastor, noster hac parte est prior: Hic pascit herbis, ille verbis panerat. Vt quinque panibus ille quinque millia Saturauit, ipse (ne saturitas noxia Anima inquinaret puritatem, vt arbitror) Ad quinque panes quinque plebis millia

page.notes: Headpiece and catchmarks at the right margin are ornaments and faint marks, not transcribed. Several lines are faint; "Sophisq;" and "vestigia" read with some doubt. Lines around "Vt namque" and "Verterque pastor" are rendered as printed in this scan (e.g. "Vt" for "Ut", "Vnde" forms), printer's spelling retained. Signature "C. ij." read at the foot; the printed "C.ȷ" is kept as "C. ij." with doubt.
